ja: • ラッシュ時の増結用に限定した２両編成の車両。神戸線の7000系、8000系の梅田寄りに連結されて運用。
• ワイド扉、扉間２枚窓の車体をはじめ、8000系３次車と同じ正面や台車などが新規パーツ。
• パンタ付き先頭車とパンタ無し先頭車のセット。
・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
en: • A two-car train limited to additional vehicles during rush hours. It is operated by being connected to the Umeda side of the Kobe Line's 7000 series and 8000 series.
• New parts include the body with wide doors and double-paned windows between the doors, as well as the same front and trolley as the 8000 series tertiary cars.
• A set of the lead car with pantograph and the lead car without pantograph.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
